reason: The final-candidate learning problem requires groups containing a positive Gold candidate and wrong candidates from the same current dense candidate distribution.
Only 35/89 outputs currently have Gold in the frozen union candidate pool; these 35 outputs were selected post-Gold and are already exposed development.
The complete current S2 feature stack (support/likelihood ranks, eight-view likelihood evidence, provenance, S2 rank) is concentrated on that exposed 35-output cohort.
Other historical labeled datasets are distribution- or task-mismatched: old sparse native/greedy pools, TTT depth-view routing, or search-order node/frontier classification.
decision: Do not train/report a selector meta-ranker as generalized evidence yet. Do not launch GPU work solely to create training data without a separate preregistered decision.
